categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies FinalizePSBT in src/psbt.cpp, directly fixing the output correctness of the finalizepsbt RPC; PSBT changes without wallet code belong to rpc per category guidance.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where finalizepsbt can return complete: true and an invalid raw transaction hex when inputs already contain final scripts. As noted in the description, ProduceSignature returns early without verifying pre-existing scriptSig or scriptWitness data, allowing transactions that fail mempool verification to be reported as complete.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes src/psbt.cpp without touching any wallet code; the wallet rubric explicitly states that a PSBT change affecting only RPC or bitcoin-tx without wallet code is rpc, not wallet.
categories.rationale: Not a wallet member because FinalizePSBT is used by non-wallet RPC machinery rather than the wallet subsystem.
